revisions.label: Rev 1.0
revisions.date_basis: Gerber job file timestamp in manufacturing zip
revisions.summary: One-input carrier for a 38-pin classic ESP32 DevKit and an external buck module; no BOM exists, so it cannot be ordered or qualified.

revisions.label: Rev 2.0
revisions.summary: First JLC-assembled ESP32-C3-WROOM-02 board with an L7805 linear 5 V rail and manual JP2 power-input selection; as-ordered resistor codes were wrong.

revisions.label: Rev 2.1
revisions.date_basis: first commit in this repo; original design date not recorded
revisions.summary: Rev 2.0 with a ground test point added; the U1 supervisor makes the ESP32 boot-loop and the board is retired.

revisions.label: Rev 2.2
revisions.date_basis: first commit in this repo; original design date not recorded
revisions.summary: Rev 2.1 with U1 left unpopulated and corrected resistor codes; still a 200 mA 3.3 V LDO and a manual jumper for input selection.

documented_quotes.what: JLCPCB quote for five fully assembled boards, before shipping and tax (pcb/ORDERING.md; the Rev 2.2 README repeats it)
Same five-board quote as cited in the Rev 2.2 README, described as historical pricing

revisions.label: Rev 3A
revisions.summary: ESP32-C3-WROOM-02 with native USB-C, AP63205 buck and automatic PIN1/PIN3 power priority; independent review rates it the best fallback with fixes.

revisions.label: Rev 3B
revisions.summary: Rev 3A power chain with a Seeed XIAO ESP32-C3 soldered flat in place of the WROOM module; viable with fixes, with module-sourcing caveats.

revisions.label: Rev 3C
revisions.summary: Socketed XIAO C3/C6 carrier with TPS1H200A input switches; blocked: U9/U10 and L1 are out of stock and a 5 V port pin leaves no margin.

documented_quotes.what: Complete JLCPCB PCB + Economic PCBA quote for 5 assembled carriers (PCB 29.81, PCBA 106.00; 83 references, 34 unique codes; excludes shipping, tax, XIAO modules)
Complete JLCPCB PCB + Economic PCBA quote for 10 assembled carriers (PCB 36.07, PCBA 135.13)
Earlier pre-STPS140Z 83-reference quote (source 7bb455f); ORDERING.md gives the 10-board figure as 168.92 in prose and 168.91 in its table
Earlier pre-STPS140Z 83-reference quote (source 7bb455f), table value (prose says 168.92)
80-reference baseline ca1fdb1 (original switches/fuses), historical comparison quote
80-reference baseline ca1fdb1 (original switches/fuses), historical comparison quote

revisions.label: Rev 3D
revisions.summary: Rev 3C with the power input replaced by TPS259470A eFuses and a FirstBuild-style topology; no supplier quote or bench test yet.

revisions.label: Rev 3E
revisions.summary: As-quoted Rev 3E with TP13-TP18 bring-up probe pads: the board behind the 2026-11-25 JLCPCB quote of $94.22 for 5 assembled boards.

documented_quotes.what: JLCPCB PCB + Economic PCBA quote for 5 as-quoted carriers before freight and tax (PCB 24.71 incl. 1 oz inner copper 16.71; assembly 69.51 incl. extended fees 24.72 = 8 x 3.09; 69 placements). Transcribed in the quote review; no quote PDF in the repo

revisions.label: Rev 3F
revisions.summary: Rev 3E with 8 regulated-rail bypass caps moved to 0603 C14663, widened In2 power traces and split eFuse paste; ChatGPT, review only.

revisions.label: Rev 3G
revisions.summary: Rev 3F service prototype: R47 replaced by cuttable JP3 link, JP4 GEA3 TX mute link, plated probe holes on TP4-TP7, closed-USB lids.

revisions.label: Rev 3H
revisions.summary: Rev 3G plus the J7 3.3 V listen-only GEA bus monitor header and C16/C17 moved to a JLC basic part; review only.

revisions.label: Rev 3I
revisions.summary: Shorter single-sided layout with the Basic C9 and a proposed half-ounce inner stack. Electrical and factory qualification remain open.

revisions.label: Rev 3J
revisions.summary: Short-axis compaction retains the protected inputs and XIAO interfaces. Routed prototype with a matching enclosure study.

revisions.label: Rev 3K
revisions.summary: 70 × 32 mm routed prototype. Recorded ERC, DRC, schematic parity and unresolved connection counts are zero. Factory and bench verification remain open.

revisions.label: Rev 3L
revisions.summary: 65 × 30 mm service prototype. All connections, including the debug LED, are routed. KiCad 9.0.9 reports zero DRC, schematic parity and ERC findings. The revised enclosure has straight guides for all three LEDs. Physical and factory checks remain open.

revisions.label: Rev 3M
revisions.summary: Compact prototype with 68 fitted parts and fixed D3/D6 interface choices. KiCad 9.0.9 reports zero open connections, DRC, parity and ERC findings. J7 and the 18 dedicated test points are omitted. Physical and factory checks remain open.
